meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 为你的问题召集多视角“思维议会”：从12种思维原型中选4-6位，各用其立场给出推理、风险和意外见解，最后综合成含共识、核心分歧、盲点、推荐路径与置信水平的总结。
howto.when: 当你面临两难、权衡或无明确答案的复杂选择，或要求多角度分析、请议会/智囊团讨论、指定魔鬼代言人时触发。

say.text: 请召集议会，帮我分析该不该辞职创业。
say.note: 将按问题类型挑选合适的思维原型进行辩论。

say.text: 用快速议会模式评估这个方案。
say.note: 议会将只选3位成员，给出简短回应。

say.text: 加入魔鬼代言人模式，对所有观点唱反调。
say.note: 每位成员都会反对最直观的看法。

howto.what_en: Summons a multi-perspective Mind Council for your question: picks 4–6 of 12 thinking archetypes, each contributes reasoning, risks, and insights, then synthesizes into convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice, ask for multiple viewpoints, request a council/panel/board discussion, or say trigger phrases like 'council mode' or 'mind council'.

say_en.text: Convene the council to help me decide whether to quit my job and start a company.
say_en.note: Archetypes will be chosen based on the question type.

say_en.text: Run a quick council on this plan.
say_en.note: Only 3 members will be selected with shorter responses.

say_en.text: Enable devil's advocate mode and challenge all positions.
say_en.note: Every member argues against the most intuitive view.
